#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Owned local HTTP fixture: ordering, mixed sources, replacement, SRI failure."""
import argparse, base64, gzip, hashlib, http.server, io, json, os, shutil
import subprocess, tarfile, tempfile, threading, time
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--jhol', type=Path, default=REPO/'target/release/jhol')
parser.add_argument('--rounds', type=int, default=10)
parser.add_argument('--stream-extract', action='store_true')
args = parser.parse_args()
args.jhol = args.jhol.resolve()

def tarball(name, version, deps=None, parent=False):
    files = {'package.json': json.dumps({'name':name,'version':version,'main':'index.js',
              'dependencies':deps or {}, **({'bin':{'order-check':'bin.js'}} if parent else {})}),
             'index.js': "module.exports=require('jhol-order-child');" if parent else f"module.exports='{version}';"}
    if parent:
        files['bin.js'] = "#!/usr/bin/env node\nconsole.log(require('./'));\n"
        files.update({f'fixture/{i}.txt':'ordering' for i in range(128)})
    raw = io.BytesIO()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=raw, mode='w') as archive:
        for path, content in files.items():
            payload = content.encode(); info = tarfile.TarInfo('package/'+path)
            info.size = len(payload); info.mode = 0o755 if path=='bin.js' else 0o644
            archive.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(payload))
    return gzip.compress(raw.getvalue(), mtime=0)

bodies = {'/parent.tgz':tarball('jhol-order-parent','1.0.0',{'jhol-order-child':'2.0.0'},True),
          '/child1.tgz':tarball('jhol-order-child','1.0.0'),
          '/child2.tgz':tarball('jhol-order-child','2.0.0')}
bodies['/short.tgz'] = bodies['/parent.tgz']
active = peak = requests = 0
mutex = threading.Lock()
class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'
    def log_message(self, *_): pass
    def do_GET(self):
        global active, peak, requests
        body = bodies.get(self.path)
        if body is None:
            self.send_response(200); self.send_header('Content-Length','2');self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(b'{}');return
        with mutex: active += 1; requests += 1; peak = max(peak,active)
        try:
            time.sleep(.08)
            self.send_response(200); self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)+(8 if self.path=='/short.tgz' else 0)))
            self.send_header('Content-Type','application/octet-stream'); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
            if self.path=='/short.tgz':self.close_connection=True
        finally:
            with mutex: active -= 1

server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler)
thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
url = f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}'
manifest = {'name':'ordered-layout-check','version':'1.0.0','private':True,
            'dependencies':{'jhol-order-parent':'1.0.0','jhol-order-child':'1.0.0'}}
lock = {'name':manifest['name'],'version':'1.0.0','lockfileVersion':3,'requires':True,
        'packages':{'':dict(manifest)}}
for path, endpoint, name, version, deps in [
    ('node_modules/jhol-order-parent','/parent.tgz','jhol-order-parent','1.0.0',{'jhol-order-child':'2.0.0'}),
    ('node_modules/jhol-order-child','/child1.tgz','jhol-order-child','1.0.0',{}),
    ('node_modules/jhol-order-parent/node_modules/jhol-order-child','/child2.tgz','jhol-order-child','2.0.0',{})]:
    lock['packages'][path] = {'name':name,'version':version,'resolved':url+endpoint,
        'integrity':'sha512-'+base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha512(bodies[endpoint]).digest()).decode(),
        'dependencies':deps,**({'bin':{'order-check':'bin.js'}} if name.endswith('parent') else {})}
checks=[]
try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='jhol-ordered-layout-') as raw:
        root=Path(raw); seed_cache=root/'seed-cache';seed_project=root/'seed-project'
        def run(case, mode='clone', shape='empty', round_no=0, grid='0'):
            global requests,peak
            project=root/f'{case}-{mode}-{shape}-{round_no}';project.mkdir();cache=root/f'cache-{case}-{mode}-{shape}-{round_no}'
            case_lock=json.loads(json.dumps(lock))
            if shape!='empty':
                shutil.copytree(prepared_cache if shape=='prepared' else seed_cache,cache)
                if shape in ('children-only','parent-only'):
                    index=json.loads((cache/'store_index.json').read_text())
                    for spec,h in index.items():
                        remove = spec.startswith('jhol-order-parent@') if shape=='children-only' else spec.startswith('jhol-order-child@')
                        if not remove: continue
                        assert len(h)==64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in h)
                        for p in (cache/'store').glob(h+'.*'): p.unlink()
                        p=cache/'store_unpacked'/h[:2]/h
                        if p.is_symlink():p.unlink()
                        elif p.exists():shutil.rmtree(p)
                if shape in ('installed-child','installed-valid'):
                    shutil.copytree(seed_project/'node_modules',project/'node_modules',symlinks=True)
                    if shape=='installed-child':
                        p=project/'node_modules/jhol-order-parent/package.json';v=json.loads(p.read_text());v['version']='0.0.0';p.write_text(json.dumps(v))
                    if shape=='installed-child':(project/'node_modules/.jhol-ok').unlink(missing_ok=True)
            if case=='bad-integrity':
                case_lock['packages']['node_modules/jhol-order-parent/node_modules/jhol-order-child']['integrity']='sha512-'+base64.b64encode(bytes(64)).decode()
            if case=='short-body':case_lock['packages']['node_modules/jhol-order-parent']['resolved']=url+'/short.tgz'
            if case=='conflicting-source':
                case_lock['packages']['node_modules/jhol-order-child']=dict(case_lock['packages']['node_modules/jhol-order-parent/node_modules/jhol-order-child'],integrity='sha512-'+base64.b64encode(bytes(64)).decode())
                case_lock['packages']['']['dependencies']['jhol-order-child']='2.0.0'
            (project/'package.json').write_text(json.dumps(case_lock['packages']['']))
            (project/'package-lock.json').write_text(json.dumps(case_lock))
            home=root/f'home-{case}-{mode}-{shape}-{round_no}';home.mkdir()
            env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('JHOL_')}
            env.update({'HOME':str(home),'JHOL_CACHE_DIR':str(cache),'JHOL_NO_HARVEST':'1','JHOL_JGRID':grid,
                'JHOL_PREBUILT':'0','JHOL_NO_DAEMON':'1','JHOL_NO_SPLASH':'1','JHOL_PROFILE_INSTALL':'1',
                'JHOL_REGISTRY':url,'NO_PROXY':'127.0.0.1,localhost'})
            env['JHOL_STREAM_EXTRACT'] = '1' if args.stream_extract else '0'
            if mode=='symlink':env['JHOL_LINK']='1'
            with mutex:requests=peak=0
            before={str(p.relative_to(project)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (project/'node_modules').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
            proc=subprocess.run([str(args.jhol),'install','--native-only'],cwd=project,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
            expected_failure=case in ('bad-integrity','conflicting-source','short-body')
            reason='';ok=proc.returncode!=0 if expected_failure else proc.returncode==0
            if expected_failure:
                after={str(p.relative_to(project)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (project/'node_modules').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
                ok=ok and (after==before if before else not (project/'node_modules/jhol-order-parent').exists())
            else:
                for path,entry in case_lock['packages'].items():
                    if not path.startswith('node_modules/'):continue
                    p=project/path/'package.json'
                    if not p.is_file() or json.loads(p.read_text()).get('version')!=entry['version']:
                        ok=False;reason='missing or incorrect locked path: '+path
                js="if(require('jhol-order-child')!=='1.0.0'||require('jhol-order-parent')!=='2.0.0')process.exit(1)"
                consumer=subprocess.run(['node','-e',js],cwd=project,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
                binary=subprocess.run([str(project/'node_modules/.bin/order-check')],cwd=project,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15) if (project/'node_modules/.bin/order-check').is_file() else None
                ok=ok and consumer.returncode==0 and binary is not None and binary.returncode==0 and binary.stdout.strip()=='2.0.0'
                if mode=='clone' and (project/'node_modules/jhol-order-parent/node_modules/jhol-order-child').is_symlink():
                    ok=False;reason='clone child repaired as shared store symlink'
            record={'case':case,'mode':mode,'shape':shape,'round':round_no,'pass':ok,'reason':reason,
                    'exit':proc.returncode,'tarball_requests':requests,'peak_concurrent_requests':peak,
                    'route_observed':'stage=layout_lookup' in proc.stderr,'prepared_route_observed':'[JGRID] L0-verified' in proc.stderr,'output':(proc.stdout+proc.stderr)[-2400:]}
            if case=='prepared-replay':record['pass']=record['pass'] and record['prepared_route_observed']
            if case=='disabled-replay':record['pass']=record['pass'] and record['route_observed'] and not record['prepared_route_observed']
            checks.append(record);print(case,mode,round_no,record['pass'],reason,flush=True)
            if case=='seed':
                shutil.copytree(cache,seed_cache);shutil.copytree(project,seed_project,symlinks=True)
            return cache,project
        run('seed')
        for r in range(args.rounds):
            for mode in ('clone','symlink'):run('cold',mode,round_no=r)
        for shape in ('children-only','parent-only','installed-child'):run('mixed',shape=shape)
        run('bad-integrity',shape='all');run('bad-integrity',shape='installed-valid');run('conflicting-source')
        run('short-body')
        prepared_cache,_=run('prepared-seed',shape='all',grid='1')
        run('prepared-replay',shape='prepared',grid='1')
        run('disabled-replay',shape='prepared')
        run('bad-integrity',shape='prepared',grid='1')
finally:
    server.shutdown();server.server_close()
    report={'binary':str(args.jhol),'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(args.jhol.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'stream_extract':args.stream_extract,
            'fixture_manifest':manifest,'fixture_lock':lock,'checks':checks,'runner_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
    out=REPO/'docs/architecture/experiments'/f'ordered-layout-check-{time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")}.json'
    out.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(out)
raise SystemExit(0 if checks and all(c['pass'] for c in checks) else 2)
